Land hits with the slug launcher to load missiles,[Alternate Weapon Action]  and then fire to launch several missiles in a volley.

Dealing damage grants one stack of 'Missiles Loaded'. Maximum of 20 stacks.

Hold [Reload] to convert these stacks into an equal number of Arc Missiles that fire on next trigger pull, dealing <pve 1138 /> <pvp [237] /> damage each.

Missiles can be fired in groups of five or all at once.
